text: Assumption: The buffer access modes Immediate and Decoupled in FrTp/FrIf decisively determine the decoupling of calling context and transmission time in the TDMA raster — is this correct?

assumption: The buffer access modes Immediate and Decoupled in FrTp/FrIf decisively determine the decoupling of calling context and transmission time in the TDMA raster.
